description: Comptage vélo - Données compteurs 2025 is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Anglet Open Data. Ce jeu de données liste, pour l'année 2025, les comptages horaires de vélos par compteur et localisation de sites de comptage. Un site de comptage peut être équipé d'un compteur dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable unidirectionnel ou de deux compteurs dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable bi-directionnel. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are comptage, vélo, compteur. The portal shows 92,133 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
